2. Petitioner as plaintiff filed the above suit for declaration of title and further declaration that the recording of RS Khatian in the name of defendant was wrong. 

 3. Plaint case in short, inter alia, that the suit land measuring 0.59 decimals of land from RS plot No. 4703 corresponding to SA plot No. 1140 under RS khatian No.326 was made in the name of Radha Rani Daisa. SA khatian No. 1820 and CS khatian No. 2106 was belonged to Radha Rani Daisa, who transferred entire land to Minal Prova Roy and other vide registered sale deed 5179 dated 9-11-1942. But in the said deed due to mistake of the deed writer CS khatian No. 2103 was written in place of 2106. Thereafter, Minal Prova Roy were remaining while new property died leaving behind 2 sons Sunil Kumar Roy and Sombhu Nath Roy as his legal heirs. During SA operation although name of Sunil Kumar Roy and Rama Roy was written but the name of Sombhu Nath Roy was left out. The said Sombhu Nath Roy and Sunil Kumar Roy thereafter transferred the suit land along with the other land to one Ranjan Kumar Roy by registered sale deed No. 5618 dated 13-9-1987. For proper care of the suit land said Ranjan Kumar Roy thereafter appointed Md Shah Alam Khan as his power of attorney holder by registered power of attorney deed being No.16008 dated 21-11-2006, who pursuant to the said power of attorney transferred the suit land to the plaintiffs by way of 3 registered sale deed Nos. 17008, 17069 and 17070 all dated 10-12-2006. By this way plaintiff after getting the property purchase remaining in possession by cultivating Irri Paddy in the suit land. Thereafter, when he went to pay the rents firstly came to know that the RS khatian is prepared in the name of respondent No.1 Kartick Chandra Das and, as such, his title became clouded, he filed the suit. 

 4. Defendant contested the suit by filing written statement, denying the plaint case alleging, inter alia, that the suit property measuring 0.59 decimals of land was originally belonged to Kartik Chandra Das. During the India and Pakistan war in the year 1965, the said Kartik Chandra Das left this country and permanently resided in India, leaving behind the property uncared of, accordingly the government :tas rightly taken the property as vested property and RS khatian has prepared in the name of government as khas land. Plaintiffs neither have title nor possession in the suit land. 

 7. PW 1 Md Amirul Islam, stated in his deposition that he is the plaintiff No.3 and got the power of attorney from the other plaintiffs to make deposition in court by way of power of attorney dated 23-3-2010. He further disclosed that suit property was belonged to Radha Rani Daisa, who is the CS recorded tenant. The CS khatian No. 2106, showing the name of recording of Radha Rani Daisa, was produced in court as Exhibit 2. The said Radha Rani Daisa along with her 2 sons Sadu Charan Mondol and Kala Charan Mondal transferred the said land by registered sale deed No. 5179 dated 9-11-1942 to Minal Prova Roy and Mukonda Chandra Roy. A certified copy of the said sale deed was produced in court. He further stated in his deposition that the said CS khatian was wrongly been written 2103 instead of 2106. He further disclosed that Minal Chandra Roy died leaving behind 2 sons Sunil Kumar Roy and Sombu Nath Roy. Subudha died childless and, as such, his property was owned and possessed by his nephew Rama Nath Roy. SA khatian No. 1820 and 1140 were correctly prepared during SA operation in the name of Sunil Kumar Roy and Rama Nath Roy. The said SA khatian No. 1820 was produced in court (Exhibit 3) by certified copy. In the said SA record Sombhu Nath Roy was wrongly been left out. Ramanath Roy died unmarried and he was inherited by her nephew Sombhu Nath Roy and Sunil Kumar Roy. Sunil Kumar Roy died leaving behind one son Somir Kumar Roy. Somir Kumar Roy and Sombu Nath Roy while owning and possessing the suit land transferred 0.59 decimals of land to Ranjan Kumar by way of registered deed No. 5618 dated 13-9-87. The said certified copy was produced in court. The said Ranjan while owning and possessing the suit land, in order to have a better caring of the property appointed one Shah Alam his attorney vide registered deed of power of attorney No. 16008 dated 21-11-2006. A certified copy of the said deed produced in court. Shah Alam while holding the power by power of attorney, transferred 0.13 decimals of land to one Md Monir Hossain vide registered sale deed No. 17068 and 0.24 decimals of land to Amirul Islam vide registered sale deed No. 17069 and rest 0.22 decimals of land to one Delowar Hossain vide registered sale deed No. 17070 all dated 10-12-2006. The certified copy of the said 3 sale deeds are produced in court. These 3 persons, who purchased the suit land are the plaintiffs in this suit. Thereafter plaintiffs by cultivating Irri paddy in the suit land owning and possessing the same. On 6-1-2008 while plaintiff going to pay the rents, firstly got to know from the defendant No.1 that RS record has prepared in the name of Kartik Chandra Roy. Thereafter, obtained a certified copy of the said RS khatian No. 326 and became confirm of the wrong recording. The said certified copy produced in court as Exhibit 

 4. Defendant neither have any title nor possession of the suit land but due to the wrong recording of RS Khatian and the title became clouded, hence he filed the suit as prayed for. He denied the defendants contention as made in the written statements are not correct. None appears to cross-examine him. 

 15. In the result, the appeal is allowed and the impugned judgment and decree dated 9-2-2015 is hereby set-aside and the suit is decreed and the plaintiffs title is hereby confirmed and the recording of RS khatian is found wrong and needs to be corrected. Since the plaintiffs title and possession found in his favour, Rule on the injunction is hereby made absolute.
